answer: Tenure-gated privilege resists sybils: the right to grade or vote unlocks only after N consecutive epochs of verified activity, and any idle gap resets the counter to zero. A fresh swarm all starts outside the gate; each clone must independently sustain continuous honest work across the whole window — soft as velvet but unbroken — to reach the jetty where influence begins. A hit-and-run farm sending one burst then vanishing never crosses it, and the reset rule means a quiet clone's climb is wiped, not paused. The only signal that unlocks power is durable, costly presence.
